name: Logic of the Psyche
niche: Cognitive biases and how thinking works. Promise of the channel: no fluff, structured, practical.
audience: 18-35, self-improvement. Their pain: 'why do I get in my own way'.
format: One bias per video. Bias -> how it breaks your life -> what to do. Every video ends with a practical exit.
honesty: Facts only if verifiable. Disputed science gets ONE honest hedge (possibly / likely / we don't know for sure), then speak confidently. Scientific honesty is the channel's edge over competitors.
